summary: Middleware is an analytics platform that helps engineering leaders measure team performance using standard DORA metrics. It processes telemetry and workflow data to track delivery speed and operational stability.
goodFor: Engineering managers who want to track deployment frequency and lead time without relying on proprietary cloud services.
watchOut: The project has a low maintenance score and modest community traction, meaning you may need to patch bugs yourself or deal with abandoned code.
deployNotes: Because the stack includes Python and Node.js packaged via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
